maya: Heads-up — nightly evals for model_candidate_1 (quantized) started hanging ~01:12 UTC. Observed on two runners.

sahil: Hmm, logs? Is it a timeout or a hard hang?

dena: Timeout then hang. Looks like worker process stops making progress after a loop of mmap calls. Paste logs:
```
[2025-11-03T01:11:59Z] eval_runner.py: starting batch 42
[2025-11-03T01:12:03Z] kv_cache.c: mmap(fd=17, len=...)=0x7f...
[2025-11-03T01:12:03Z] kv_cache.c: mmap(fd=18, len=...)=0x7f...
[2025-11-03T01:12:03Z] kv_cache.c: mmap failed: Too many open files
[2025-11-03T01:12:04Z] eval_runner.py: worker stuck, not responding to heartbeat
```

maya: "Too many open files" — sounds like FD leak. This only shows up in quantized path with mono-build (single process mmap cache).

jorge: I saw a similar pattern last week during the multi-GPU quant runs. Could be the mmap cache not closing on error. PR that touched cache lifetime: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/2435 (commit 3a7f2c4)

ci-bot: nightly-evals/quantized (runner-13) failed at 1789504321 — job cancelled after 30m timeout

sahil: Repro steps I used:
```
GOMAXPROCS=1 pytest tests/evals/test_candidate.py::test_quantized_mmap_repro -q -k mmap --maxfail=1
```
I could reproduce 3/5 runs.

dena: Quick workaround: increase ulimit for open files to 65536 or restart eval-workers. But that's just masking the leak.

maya: Can someone bisect? If it's PR 2435, we should revert or patch to close fds in finally block.

jorge: I'll run a bisect tomorrow AM. Also adding FD accounting in harness: dump `/proc/<pid>/fd | wc -l` every minute.

sahil: I'll add a small patch to ensure `munmap`/`close(fd)` in the error path; push as a hotfix if it helps.

dena: Also add an integration test that opens mmap in loop and asserts FD count stable.

maya: Great. Filing a ticket: INF-7123. Tagging eng-oncall for elevated infra impact. @eng-oncall please note :eyes: 

ci-bot: INF-7123 created by maya — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7123

jorge: Thanks. Will report back with bisect + minimal repro before EOD.

sahil: If anyone hits this and needs immediate runs, use the 'stable-evals' pool which uses the older cache implementation.

maya: Copy. Thanks all :heart:
